about: SDK 3.0.0 raw golden test (make_golden_raw.py, reference golden_raw.py). Per case: `build`, `tolerance_entry` (the build's value in the manifest's golden_raw_tolerance, or null), `clips` (id, kind, expected_tokens, and the heads of the CPU and accelerator runs as [frame][class] float32 values), and `expect`: `tolerance` in force (null: tokens only), `measures` per compared head (token_edits, lp_mean, lp_p99, frames; attr: p_mean, values), `failed` (the measures out of tolerance, in order), `pass` and `reason` (null, golden_mismatch or cpu_mismatch). A case that fails also has `divergence`: the `detail.divergence` object of its promotion_failed incident report (`tokens_expected`: the CPU's greedy tokens of log_probs over the clean clips; `heads`: the measures; `tolerance`: the one in force, left out when there is none; `failed`), whose `detail.cause` is the reason. Compare numbers to 1e-6.
p99_index: (99 * n + 99) // 100 - 1 on the ascending list of n frame distances

cases.name: identical outputs, no tolerance
cases.about: The accelerator returns the CPU's values: every measure is 0.

cases.name: small differences, within the tolerance
cases.about: Noise of at most 0.01 on every value of three heads and two attribute heads; the coreml numbers of SPEC section 5.

cases.name: small differences, no tolerance
cases.about: The same outputs judged without a tolerance: the tokens are identical, so it passes; lp_mean, lp_p99 and p_mean are recorded and not checked.

cases.name: one token differs on a clean clip, no tolerance
cases.about: The accelerator's frame 4 of clean_a has another winner (token 4 where the CPU has 3): 2 4 4 against 2 3 4, one substitution.

cases.name: one token differs on a clean clip, tolerance token_edits 0
cases.about: The same outputs with the coreml tolerance: token_edits 1 is above 0, and the swapped frame also lifts lp_mean and lp_p99 above their limits.

cases.name: one token differs on a clean clip, tolerance token_edits 1
cases.about: The same outputs with a tolerance that allows one edit and wide distances.

cases.name: a token differs on the planted clip only
cases.about: The planted clip is a known int8 against float difference: its tokens are not counted (token_edits 0), its frames enter lp_mean and lp_p99. No tolerance: passes.

cases.name: a deletion and an insertion
cases.about: clean_a loses its token 3 (2 4 against 2 3 4) and clean_b gains a 4 (3 | 2 4 2 against 3 | 2 2): the edit distance is 1 on each clip, 2 in all.

cases.name: lp_mean above the tolerance
cases.about: Noise of at most 0.25: no token changes, lp_mean is above 0.05 and lp_p99 is within 1.5.

cases.name: 150 frames, one outlier frame
cases.about: One frame of 150 differs by about 3; every other frame by at most 0.01. The 99th percentile is the value at index (99 * 150 + 99) // 100 - 1 = 148 of the ascending list, the second largest, so lp_p99 stays small and the test passes against lp_p99 1.5.

cases.name: 150 frames, two outlier frames
cases.about: Two frames differ by about 3 and about 2.5: index 148 is now the smaller of the two outliers, above 1.5, while lp_mean stays within 0.05.

cases.name: clipping to [-30, 0]
cases.about: Values below -30 on both sides count as -30 (a distance of 0 where both are below; 0.5 for -29.5 against -40), and an accelerator value above 0 counts as 0.

cases.name: p_mean above the tolerance
cases.about: The gem head differs by up to 0.3 per value while attr_qalqalah is identical: p_mean is pooled over both heads and is above 0.02.

cases.name: p_mean without an attr entry
cases.about: The same outputs against a tolerance that has no `attr` entry: p_mean is recorded and not checked.

cases.name: a head without an entry is judged on tokens only
cases.about: The NPU tolerance of SPEC section 5 names log_probs only. inter1_log_probs differs by up to 0.4 per value with the same tokens: recorded, not checked. timing_log_probs (20 ms frames) is identical.

cases.name: a malformed tolerance entry
cases.about: The entry's lp_mean is a string, so the build has no tolerance (and no signed line): judged on tokens only. The same outputs fail against the well-formed entry in the case `lp_mean above the tolerance`.

cases.name: cpu_mismatch
cases.about: The CPU run of clean_b gives 3 | 2 2 and the self-test file expects 3 | 2: the CPU path is not the reference, whatever the accelerator returns.

cases.name: cpu_mismatch on the planted clip, with a token difference
cases.about: The expected tokens are checked on every clip, planted ones too, and cpu_mismatch is the reason even when the accelerator also differs.

cases.name: a different number of frames
cases.about: The accelerator returns one frame less for clean_a: the head cannot be compared (`log_probs.shape`), it has no measures and the test fails.

cases.name: a tie goes to the lower id
cases.about: In frame 1 of clean_a the accelerator gives blank and token 2 the same value: blank wins, the token is still emitted at frame 2, so the tokens are the CPU's.
